# Hospitals

This folder catalogs Danish hospitals, healthcare clusters, and specialized facilities evaluated in the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual reports. Each page details a specific institution's performance against national clinical quality indicators, such as echocardiography completion rates, anticoagulation treatment coverage, and adverse outcomes like severe bleeding or ischemic stroke. The data highlights institutional compliance with standards set by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), noting methodological caveats like the consolidated reporting for Sygehus Lillebælt and the statistical limitations of small facilities like Samsø Sundheds og Akuthus.

## Pages

- [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital Thisted]] — A department under Aalborg Universitetshospital, noted for high long-term anticoagulation compliance but falling short on echocardiography standards.
- [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] — A major hospital in Region Nordjylland tracked for atrial fibrillation treatment quality, showing strong long-term anticoagulation coverage but room for improvement in echocardiography.
- [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] — A major hospital in Region Midtjylland that met national standards for echocardiography and is tracked for adverse outcomes like severe bleeding and mortality.
- [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] — A Capital Region hospital with mixed compliance, meeting long-term anticoagulation standards at two years but falling short on echocardiography and five-year treatment coverage.
- [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]] — A combined Capital Region hospital organization that met initial treatment standards but recorded low compliance for echocardiography.
- [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] — A Region Sjælland hospital that met national standards for both early treatment initiation and echocardiography performance.
- [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] — A combined reporting unit in Region Syddanmark that fell short of the national standard for echocardiography in newly diagnosed patients.
- [[herlev-og-gentofte-hospital|Herlev og Gentofte Hospital]] — A Capital Region hospital that significantly missed the national standard for echocardiography and struggled with initial anticoagulation wait times.
- [[holbaek|Holbæk]] — Holbæk Sygehus in Region Sjælland, which met standards for echocardiography and early anticoagulation but missed the five-year treatment coverage target.
- [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]] — A Capital Region hospital group that met initial treatment timelines but narrowly missed targets for diagnostic screening and long-term anticoagulation.
- [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] — A Region Midtjylland unit recognized for strong clinical performance and its systematic, interdisciplinary approach to patient education via its atrial fibrillation clinic.
- [[hospitalsenheden-vest|Hospitalsenheden Vest]] — A Region Midtjylland administrative unit that fell short of the national standard for long-term anticoagulation treatment coverage.
- [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] — A Region Syddanmark hospital whose data must be interpreted collectively with Vejle Sygehus as Sygehus Lillebælt due to registry allocation issues.
- [[naestved-sygehus|Næstved Sygehus]] — A Region Sjælland hospital that met the standard for structured patient education on a small cohort but missed the target for echocardiography.
- [[nykoebing-falster|Nykøbing Falster]] — Nykøbing Falster Hospital in Region Sjælland, which fell below the required threshold for echocardiography in newly diagnosed patients.
- [[ouh-odense-universitetshospital|OUH Odense Universitetshospital]] — A major Region Syddanmark hospital that narrowly missed the echocardiography standard but successfully met initial anticoagulation wait time targets.
- [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]] — A Region Nordjylland hospital demonstrating strong performance, including the highest proportion of anticoagulation treatment coverage in a broader analysis.
- [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] — A Region Midtjylland hospital that successfully met national standards for both echocardiography and anticoagulation treatment coverage.
- [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] — A Region Midtjylland hospital that exceeded the echocardiography standard and performed well on initial treatment, though long-term coverage declined over time.
- [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] — A Region Midtjylland hospital showing strong compliance with national benchmarks for both echocardiography and anticoagulation treatment coverage.
- [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] — A major Capital Region hospital that fell below national standards for echocardiography and recorded the lowest five-year anticoagulation coverage among listed hospitals.
- [[samso-sundheds-og-akuthus|Samsø Sundheds og Akuthus]] — A small island facility with an extremely small patient sample size, used in reports to illustrate the statistical challenges of benchmarking small populations.
- [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-koenge|Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge]] — A Region Sjælland hospital that missed the national standard for echocardiography but met targets for initial anticoagulation treatment.
- [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-roskilde|Sjællands Universitetshospital Roskilde]] — A Region Sjælland hospital that successfully met national standards for both echocardiography and early treatment initiation.
- [[slagelse-sygehus|Slagelse Sygehus]] — A Region Sjælland hospital that met the standard for structured patient education on a small cohort but fell short on echocardiography completion.
- [[steno-diabetes-center|Steno Diabetes Center]] — A specialized hospital with extremely low patient volumes for atrial fibrillation, resulting in wide confidence intervals and insufficient data for broad comparisons.
- [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] — A Region Sjælland healthcare cluster that met the standard for timely anticoagulation initiation and is tracked for stroke incidence and adverse outcomes.
- [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] — A health cluster centered around Sjællands Universitetshospital, meeting standards for timely treatment initiation and tracked in national geographic mappings for stroke incidence.
- [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]] — A Region Syddanmark hospital organization serving as a combined reporting entity for Kolding and Vejle hospitals due to underlying registry data allocation issues.
- [[sygehus-soenderjylland|Sygehus Sønderjylland]] — A Region Syddanmark hospital that met the echocardiography standard and noted a data collection discrepancy regarding TSH measurements in its emergency department.
- [[vejle-sygehus|Vejle Sygehus]] — A Region Syddanmark hospital that met the echocardiography standard, though its data must be interpreted collectively with Kolding Sygehus as Sygehus Lillebælt.
